formulas.full_cross_panel_rival_covariance_entrie: (P*J)^2; three identified seed/calendar/interaction components when model is justified
formulas.planning_fit_jobs: P*(N_stochastic*S_pilot + N_deterministic), S_pilot>=5; candidate included in N_stochastic
formulas.confirmation_fit_jobs: P*(N_stochastic*R + N_deterministic), R>=10 only if full-rule power at declared T supports it
formulas.additional_HPO_and_failures: Separate actual jobs/attempt caps; fixed-recipe execution manifest requires HPO finished.
formulas.serial_fit_cap_seconds: sum of explicit per-job operational caps; not a measured elapsed-time estimate
formulas.total_material_cost: preparation + HPO + planning + final fits + prediction + storage + calibration/power + reporting + failed attempts; each from measured/authorized inputs

missing_material_inputs: pilot/final seed lists and selected R/T
per-fit operational caps and measured schedule if elapsed time is claimed
attempt and wall-clock budgets with authentic authorization
